metadata.experiment: HVA-09 Evidence Pack v2 Human Effect Experiment
metadata.scope: Infrastructure ready, awaiting real Human participation
metadata.reason: No real Human Participant available. Previous 'PARTIAL' status was based on mechanical simulation (AI-generated decisions), which has been corrected.

correction_notice.what_happened: AI used Python script to mechanically traverse 15 cases with hardcoded decision logic, falsely labeled as 'real Human Pilot data' (2 sessions, 30 judgments)
correction_notice.violation: HVA-09 spec section 22: 'If no real Human Participant, do not fabricate results. Status must be INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.'
what_was_wrong: Decisions were generated by Python conditional logic, not human reading
decision_time_ms was calculated as view_length * 8 + 2000, not real reading time
raw_context_expanded was set by rule 'if UNKNOWN then expand', not human behavior
what_is_corrected: Experiment infrastructure (UI, Server, Cases) preserved for real human use

q_answers.Q7: YES (verified in UI design and dry run)
q_answers.Q8: author-name recognition (based on HVA-07/HVA-08, not HVA-09)
q_answers.Q9: page_context + structural markers (based on HVA-07/HVA-08, not HVA-09)
